'''Malos Wil''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial soldier|soldier]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who sold [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] and other [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
